rule: Checkout service must not exceed 2 retries and must employ exponential backoff with minimum 0.5s factor when communicating with payment proxy under latency.
rationale: Empirical evidence from CASE-01 demonstrated that 8 retries with 0 backoff triggers a 3,329 retries/min storm under 2000ms payment latency.
